open_points.subject: M27 agent_name uniqueness enforcement
open_points.text: "names are unique in an installation, and a configuration repeating one is refused at start."
open_points.question: Which module enforces unique agent names, and is that check applied only at startup or also on per-request token-list re-read?
options: installation validates agent-name uniqueness on every successful token-list re-read too
surface enforces after installation returns tokens
open_points.default_guess: installation enforces uniqueness both at startup and on token-list re-read, refusing requests when invalid

open_points.subject: Random ID minting for M07/M11/M19/M24/M25
open_points.text: "trial_execution_id M07, binding_id M11, run_id M19, approval_id M24 and grant_id M25 are minted at random by the kernel; one that already exists is minted again."
open_points.question: Which module owns ID generation and collision retry for these random identifiers?
options: each owning domain module mints its own IDs
store mints IDs inside write transactions
a shared utility module mints IDs and callers retry on conflict
open_points.default_guess: store mints and retries inside the same transaction that writes each record
